keywordRouting._note: Stream 2A 2026-09-09. The generic keyword router. Rungs here are the ones whose mechanism is not Salesforce-specific (TypeText / PickList / ComboBox / ClickCheckbox / ClickText / ClickItem / VerifyText). A family whose only proven rung is a Salesforce one carries a stated reason rather than borrowing it -- 12-copado-commit-changes.html parses under THIS template (it carries no Lightning markers), and before this block its inputs fell through to a bare ClickItem with nothing said about why.

date.why: a generic date input is typed as text -- Set Datetime drives Salesforce's two-control compound and does not apply here.

datetime.why: typed as text; the Salesforce compound-control rung is not portable.

lookup.why: a type-to-search control; ComboBox must not blur after typing.

slider.reason: a drag gesture has no read-back rung on any platform we own.

output_field.reason: a rendered read-only value -- nothing to fill; assert its text.

button.reason: a button is actuated by a click rung (ClickText / ClickItem), not filled or asserted as a value.

link.reason: a link is actuated by a click rung (ClickText / ClickItem), not filled or asserted as a value.

tree.reason: a tree item is actuated by a click rung (ClickText / ClickItem), not filled or asserted as a value.

pill.reason: a pill shows a chosen value; set it through the control that produced it.

badge.reason: rendered status text -- assert it, never fill it.

iframe.reason: an iframe is a FRAME, not a control -- drive what is inside it.

_default.reason: no keywordRouting row is declared for this family in the generic template -- add one once a platform-neutral keyword is proven. Stated absence, never silence.

file.reason: a file input needs an upload rung; the one we own (Upload File To Record) is Salesforce-specific.

grid.why: row/col addressing is structural and platform-neutral.

table.why: row/col addressing is structural and platform-neutral.

row.why: row/col addressing is structural and platform-neutral.

cell.why: row/col addressing is structural and platform-neutral.

rowheader.why: row/col addressing is structural and platform-neutral.

columnheader.reason: a column header is an ARGUMENT to the table rungs, not a control.

tab.reason: a tab is actuated by a click rung (ClickText / ClickItem), not filled or asserted as a value.

tabpanel.reason: a tab panel is content, not a control.

option.reason: an option is a VALUE inside a listbox -- the argument to PickList / ComboBox, never a control of its own.

listbox.reason: a listbox is the popup a combobox opens -- drive the control.

progress.reason: rendered status -- assert it as text.

label.reason: a label NAMES a control -- it is the locator argument, not a target.

presentation.reason: role=presentation is explicitly not a control.

custom.reason: an unrecognised custom element has no proven keyword.

hostInnerCollapse._why: interop T16 2026-09-07, read by v3._collapse_host_inner. T14 priced v3's missing dedup pass at 27.1 points of precision: 87 of its 91 false positives were the SAME control emitted twice -- li[role=treeitem] plus the <a> inside it (57 in one Setup nav tree), and a <label> beside the control it captions under a lightning-input-field host (11 in Zoo_Aura_v3). A drop happens ONLY when a second element is provably the same control (nested within maxDepth AND same label, or a caption-family element duplicating a real control under a shared ancestor). Different labels mean different controls -- the tree grid's columnheader contains its column-action button and both survive. Set enabled:false to restore the pre-T16 output byte for byte.

note_labelPolicy: interop T10 2026-09-07: the label POLICY layer, read by tools/interop/resources/pythonDom/element_compiler.py through DomConfiguration. labelPrecedence names are the label_source values the compiler emits; the first rung that resolves wins. Omit a key here and the compiler falls back to its own class attribute.
note_labelPrecedence: labelPrecedence: `inner_text` is FIRST as of the wave-2 review close (stream P1, 2026-09-07, findings F6/R12). THE LABEL IS WHAT A PERSON SEES -- a title tooltip or an ARIA accessible name labels a control only when nothing visible does. Measured before the move: 110 elements across the 144-capture corpus carried a title_attr label while their own rendered_text said something else. `inner_text` only produces a value for button/a/role=button, so form controls are unaffected and an icon-only control still falls through to title_attr. `assistive_text` is last: never visible, but on a chevron-only button it is the only handle there is.
note_assistiveTextClassFragments: assistiveTextClassFragments: class fragments marking SCREEN-READER-ONLY text. Text inside one of these is stripped from every visible-label candidate and is only offered by the last `assistive_text` rung of labelPrecedence, with its own label_source. Added by the wave-2 review close (stream P1, 2026-09-07, finding F11) -- was a literal tuple in element_compiler.py, which is why 'inner_text' concatenated 'Show more navigation items' onto the visible '* More'.

labelSourceCaveats.assistive_text: This label came from SCREEN-READER-ONLY markup (an slds-assistive-text / sr-only span) -- nothing on this control is visible to a sighted person, so a rendered-text search may not find it. Confirm the click landed (read-back or the optical witness) before trusting this step.

note_labelSourceCaveats: labelSourceCaveats: a caveat appended to every hint whose locator IS the label, keyed by the labelPrecedence rung that produced that label. Added by the wave-2 review close (stream P1, 2026-09-07, finding F11 / L2-R08): a hint built on assistive text must say so rather than read as if the string were visible on the page.
note_innerTextExcludedRoles: innerTextExcludedRoles: roles whose own rendered text is the control's VALUE, not its NAME, so the `inner_text` rung (first, since the wave-2 review close) must never claim them. A Lightning picklist is <button role="combobox" aria-label="Industry">--None--</button>; without this key the field's label became '--None--'. Added by stream P1, 2026-09-07, after its own test caught the regression in the org map's metadata->control routing.
